headline: Ramayana leads the outlook, with its next-hour tickets expected near 49.2K to 57.1K ahead of a stronger Friday.
bullets: Namit Malhotra's Ramayana is at 54.9K now and could reach 57.1K in the 5–6 PM hour (range 46.2K to 68.4K), up 281% on yesterday.
Aadarsha Kutumbam is at 1.8K now, with the next hours expected between 1.3K and 1.7K, down 3 versus yesterday.
Jailer 2 is expected to reach 23.8K today (range 21K to 29.6K) and 25.1K tomorrow (range 20K to 40.8K), down 35 versus yesterday.
Review and word-of-mouth information is not included yet, so these are estimates from ticket history only.
watch: Friday's new releases opening could shift tomorrow's numbers, especially for Jailer 2 where the range is wide.
Diwali on 2026-11-08 is approaching and could change demand for all three films.
